sd_jpg_viewer_open.tooltip: Open an image file from the SD card and enter viewer mode

sd_jpg_viewer_next.tooltip: Page forward; returns whether viewing continues

sd_jpg_viewer_prev.tooltip: Page back; returns whether viewing continues

sd_jpg_viewer_exit.tooltip: Exit the image viewer and free memory

sd_jpg_viewer_zoom.tooltip: Toggle between full-page view and zoomed view

sd_jpg_viewer_pan.tooltip: Move the viewport by screen-size multiples in zoomed mode

sd_jpg_viewer_dir.tooltip: Toggle reading direction in zoomed mode (right-to-left / left-to-right)
